## Description
Briefly describe the change, rationale, and impact.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking enhancement)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix/feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Security / Hardening improvement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] Smoke tests pass (`npm test` / `node scripts/smoke-test.mjs`)
- [ ] Manual verification completed on local server (`http://127.0.0.1:5173`)
- [ ] Zero lint/syntax regressions
